# Learn

Hands-on tutorials that teach the `barangay` package by example. Work through them in order if you are new to the library.

> **Status:** Hub — learning path ordering.

## Learning path

1. **[Database API](database-api.qmd)** — browse, look up, traverse hierarchy, fuzzy search, validate, and export. The foundation tutorial.
2. **[Address Validation](address-validation.qmd)** — validate Philippine addresses against the PSGC masterlist with fuzzy matching.
3. **[Bulk Barangay Lookup](bulk-barangay-lookup.qmd)** — batch processing and vectorized matching at scale.

If you have not installed the package yet, start with [Get Started](../get-started/index.qmd).
